description: Returns the profile of a person or company on a connected LinkedIn or Instagram account. Person (profileType=person): identifier is 'me', a messaging-thread participant identifier, a provider person id (the author id of a post or comment, the sender id of a reaction, the user id of a connection invitation), a LinkedIn public profile slug, or an Instagram username. Company (profileType=company, LinkedIn only): identifier is a Sales Navigator company id or the company_id of a current_positions entry; 'me' returns the company pages the account administers as items with id, name and messaging_enabled, and such an id is the page id accepted as postAs when publishing and commentAs when commenting. Returns id, profile_type, display_name, headline, location, profile and picture urls, follower and relation counts, network distance and current_positions (company, role, company_id). The returned id is reusable with the same profileType and, for a person, as the author id for listing posts. The headline and description arrive between untrusted-content markers. An invalid identifier returns a validation error.

connectedAccountId.description: The id of a connected workspace account with provider LinkedIn or Instagram and status 'ok'

identifier.description: Person: 'me'; a messaging-thread participant identifier; a provider person id (a profile id, the author id of a post or comment, the sender id of a reaction, or the user id of a connection invitation); a LinkedIn Classic public profile slug; or an Instagram username. Company (profileType=company): a Sales Navigator company id, as found in a company search or in the company_id of a current_positions entry on a lead search result, a Sales Navigator list row or a person profile; 'me' with profileType=company lists the company pages the account administers

profileType.description: What to retrieve: person (default) or company. Company lookup requires a LinkedIn account

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: get_social_profile

outputSchema.description: A profile returns its fields; identifier 'me' with profileType=company returns items.

title: Get person or company profile
